data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after an enemy unit picks its targets.

**Target:** A **LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE** unit of yours that the enemy unit picked as a target.

**Effect:** Whenever a melee attack destroys a model of the unit that has not fought in the phase, roll a D6, for the rest of the phase. On a 4+, the model stays on the battlefield: it can fight once all attacks of the attacking unit are done, and is removed afterwards.

effects.trigger: model destroyed by a melee attack
effects.condition: model has not fought this phase
effects.then: not removed; fights after the attacking unit finishes its attacks, then removed from play
